_comment: The capability that did not exist until now: fixing itself. Every source name here is unique because the ladder has a per-source cooldown — reusing one would make the second case report 'cooling down' and pass for the wrong reason.

cases.why: recycling the browser is seconds — it must be tried before anything expensive, and he must not hear about it
cases.source: recovery.ladder — cheapest rung first, silent while it works

cases.why: the night of 26 August needed the third rung — a ladder that stops at the first failure would have stayed broken
cases.source: the leaked-browser outage: recycle alone would not have cleared a damaged profile

cases.why: this is the ONLY case that is his — and the message has to name what was tried, or it is an alarm rather than a report
a network that has not reassociated after the lid opens fails one poll — repairing on that would relaunch a browser every minute
cases.source: recovery.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD — one failure is a hiccup, three is a pattern

cases.why: the blunt repair is exactly what is needed when the delicate one is too broken to run
cases.source: recovery.ladder catches a rung's exception and continues
